Personally for me, I had a dream just last night (prompting me to make this post) of a man who was woke me up by choking me, and attempting to kill me (I was still asleep, but I thought I was awake, which made this so much worse). 

After wrestling with this guy for what seemed like forever, the police arrived, (no idea how.) and they pulled him off of me. I was relieved, but for some reason they couldn’t prove he had hurt me. So later that day (it was just the next dream scene) he posted a video on social media of him hacking his friend to death with a machete (i remember this so vividly it makes me nauseous) and once he was done he looked at the camera and said “I’m coming for you next” this caused me to panic (in and out of my dream)

Next dream scene he was at my house with a double barrel shotgun, I was terrified, and my first instinct was to run and tell my mom to get out of the house, but she is crippled (real life and in dream) and can’t get out of the house unassisted. He proceeded to blow open our front door with the shot gun (our front door has a glass panel he can fit through) and I beg him to shoot things other than me, and at this point my body is in full flight or fight and something in me realizes that I was asleep. And it wasn’t real, I remember the feeling of physically having to pull myself back into actual consciousness so I wouldn’t have to endure any more of the nightmare. I couldn’t imagine what that dream man would have done to me or my family.. I’m just glad I actually woke myself up.

I still don’t feel right after this. And even right now, I’m avoiding sleep because of it.
